newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINE BONDS EDGE HIGHER, LISTLESS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINE BONDS EDGE HIGHER, LISTLESS TRADE.

text.p: Argentine bonds were higher late morning Tuesday, as the market pushed higher in dull trade with U.S. Treasuries.
"It is very quiet. The market does not really have any direction," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Argentina's Par Brady bond edged up 1/8 to 73-3/4. The dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was up $0.20 at 120.05.
Traders said the market was waiting for U.S. retail sales figures due for release Wednesday.
"They will give direction," said another trader.
